## Motivation

In multi-LoRA serving (`python/sglang/srt/lora/eviction_policy.py` and `python/sglang/srt/lora/mem_pool.py`), `LoRAMemoryPool.prepare_lora_batch` runs before every forward batch to mark active adapters as used and allocate buffer slots for missing adapters:

1. **`LRUEvictionPolicy.select_victim` and `FIFOEvictionPolicy.select_victim`** materialized a full `list(self.access_order.keys())` / `list(self.insertion_order.keys())` copy on every eviction even though neither dictionary is mutated during iteration.
2. **`LRUEvictionPolicy.mark_used`** called `self.access_order.pop(uid, None)` followed by re-insertion on every batch access instead of `OrderedDict.move_to_end(uid)`, and eagerly formatted f-strings for `logger.debug` even when `DEBUG` logging is disabled.
3. **`LoRAMemoryPool.prepare_lora_batch`** rescanned `range(self.max_loras_per_batch)` from index `0` and rebuilt the `candidates` and `non_none_candidates` sets from scratch for *every* missing adapter in the batch ($O(K \cdot M)$ for $K$ missing adapters and pool capacity $M$).

## Modifications

- **`python/sglang/srt/lora/eviction_policy.py`**:
  - Iterate directly over `self.access_order` / `self.insertion_order` in `select_victim` without allocating a temporary `list` of keys.
  - Use `self.access_order.move_to_end(uid)` in `LRUEvictionPolicy.mark_used` and lazy `%s` formatting in `logger.debug(...)` calls.
- **`python/sglang/srt/lora/mem_pool.py`**:
  - Return early in `prepare_lora_batch` when all requested adapters are already resident in `self.uid_to_buffer_id`.
  - Collect `empty_slots`, `non_none_candidates`, and `has_none_candidate` in a single $O(M)$ pass when misses occur, and consume empty slots / evicted victims incrementally in $O(1)$ per missing adapter while preserving deterministic slot order and base-model (`None`) last-resort fallback.
- **`test/registered/unit/lora/test_eviction_policy.py`**:
  - Added `test_prepare_lora_batch_multi_eviction_and_base_fallback` verifying multi-adapter eviction ordering, pinned-adapter preservation, base-model (`None`) fallback, and `ValueError` when all slots are pinned.

## Acknowledgments & Prior Work

Builds on and credits the LoRA eviction policy and memory pool architecture by @ConnorLi96 (#11041), @liuhuijiayou (#21381), @wangalrebt (#22621), and @glenliu21 (#22640).

## Accuracy & Unit Test Verification

```bash
pytest test/registered/unit/lora/test_eviction_policy.py -v
# 6 passed, 6 subtests passed
```

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).

+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from sglang.srt.lora.eviction_policy import get_eviction_policy
+from sglang.srt.lora.mem_pool import EMPTY_SLOT, LoRAMemoryPool
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestLoRAEvictionBatchPrep(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_prepare_lora_batch_multi_eviction_and_base_fallback(self):
+        """prepare_lora_batch allocates empty slots in order, evicts multiple adapters, and falls back to None last."""
+        pool = LoRAMemoryPool.__new__(LoRAMemoryPool)
+        pool.max_loras_per_batch = 4
+        pool.buffer_id_to_uid = [EMPTY_SLOT] * 4
+        pool.uid_to_buffer_id = {}
+        pool.eviction_policy = get_eviction_policy("lru")
+        loaded = []
+        pool.load_lora_weight_to_buffer = lambda uid, buf_id, *args: loaded.append(
+            (uid, buf_id)
+        )
+
+        # Fill all 4 slots one by one so slot assignment and LRU order are deterministic
+        for idx, uid in enumerate([None, "lora1", "lora2", "lora3"]):
+            pool.prepare_lora_batch({uid}, {}, [], {}, None, None)
+            self.assertEqual(pool.uid_to_buffer_id[uid], idx)
+        self.assertEqual(pool.buffer_id_to_uid, [None, "lora1", "lora2", "lora3"])
+
+        # Refresh lora1 so LRU order among LoRA adapters is lora2 (oldest), lora3, lora1; pin lora2
+        pool.prepare_lora_batch({"lora1"}, {}, [], {}, None, None)
+        lora_refs = {"lora2": SimpleNamespace(pinned=True)}
+
+        # Request 3 new adapters in a single batch:
+        # Must skip pinned lora2 (slot 2), evict lora3 (slot 3) and lora1 (slot 1) first, then None (slot 0).
+        loaded.clear()
+        pool.prepare_lora_batch(
+            {"lora4", "lora5", "lora6"}, {}, [], lora_refs, None, None
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            set(pool.uid_to_buffer_id.keys()), {"lora2", "lora4", "lora5", "lora6"}
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(pool.uid_to_buffer_id["lora2"], 2)
+        self.assertEqual([buf_id for _, buf_id in loaded], [3, 1, 0])
+
+        # When all non-current slots are pinned, prepare_lora_batch must raise ValueError
+        all_pinned = {
+            uid: SimpleNamespace(pinned=True)
+            for uid in ("lora2", "lora4", "lora5", "lora6")
+        }
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "No available buffer slots found"):
+            pool.prepare_lora_batch({"lora7"}, {}, [], all_pinned, None, None)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main(verbosity=2)
